title: Paper Maze Klotski
description: Immerse yourself in exquisite storybook paper-cut art—slide ornate blocks across atmospheric puzzle boards to guide the hero through mysterious realms.
controls: Slide rectangular paper blocks horizontally or vertically to clear a path for the hero piece to exit.

zh-CN.title: 纸中迷境华容道
zh-CN.description: 高颜值国风剪纸美学纸中迷境华容道：精致纸雕画风配经典滑块华容道解谜，步步推演打开迷境通途！
zh-CN.controls: 上下左右滑动精致的纸雕模块腾出空间，引导主角木块顺利滑出迷境出口。
